1. System Authentication & Login Screen Guide

Each coaching institute logs into CoachGenie through its assigned tenant subdomain.

FIGURE 1.0: AUTHENTIC COACHGENIE LOGIN INTERFACE (http://localhost:3000/login) LIVE UI CAPTURE

1.1 Step-by-Step Login Instructions

  • Step 1 (Subdomain): Enter your coaching institute subdomain (e.g. demo). This loads your institute's isolated database tenant.
  • Step 2 (Credentials): Enter your assigned email address and password.
  • Step 3 (Authentication): Click Sign In. Session cookies (cg_access_token) are issued automatically.
SECURITY NOTICE: Passwords must be at least 8 characters. After 15 minutes of inactivity, session tokens expire automatically for security.

3. Sales Leads & Kanban Pipeline Guide

Counselors manage prospective student inquiries using an 8-stage interactive sales pipeline (/leads).

FIGURE 3.0: SALES PIPELINE KANBAN BOARD (8 PIPELINE STAGES) LIVE UI CAPTURE

3.1 Pipeline Stages & Actions

  • Stages: New → Contacted → Interested → Demo Scheduled → Demo Done → Negotiation → Enrolled → Lost.
  • Adding a Lead: Click + Add Lead, fill full name, mobile number, target course, and lead source.
  • Converting a Lead: Click Convert Lead when a student enrolls to populate their record directly into Admissions.

4. Admissions & Student Directory Guide

Admissions applications and active student directory entries (/students and /admissions).

FIGURE 4.0: STUDENT DIRECTORY INTERFACE LIVE UI CAPTURE

4.1 Admission & Student Record Workflow

  • Student Directory Table: Search students by name, enrollment number, or phone. View batch enrollments.
  • Admissions Verification: Review uploaded student documents, approve applications, and auto-generate unique enrollment IDs (e.g. STU-2026-001).

5. Fee Invoices & Payment Billing Guide

Manage student fee structures, invoice generation, and payment logs (/fees).

FIGURE 5.0: FEE INVOICES & PAYMENT MANAGEMENT INTERFACE LIVE UI CAPTURE

5.1 Recording Payments & Automatic Status Updates

  • Creating an Invoice: Select student, choose fee template, specify total amount, discount, and due date.
  • Recording Payment: Click Record Payment, enter payment amount (e.g. ₹5,000) and mode (Cash/UPI).
  • Auto State Settlement: When total paid equals total due, the invoice status automatically updates from PENDING to PAID.
